name: invoices-fn-overdue-accounts
evidence: pkg_dunning.fn_overdue_accounts (05_pkg_dunning.sql:21-29, ap-46a8eb988b) and sp_schedule_dunning driver (:40-42, ap-644c102b12): invoices in status 40 (overdue); the tenants outer join is dropped so the op stays inside the unit
source_sql: SELECT i.id AS "invoiceId", i.tenant_id AS "tenantId", i.period_id AS "periodId", i.issued_at AS "issuedAt", i.total AS "total" FROM invoices i WHERE i.status_cd = 40

name: invoices-fn-invoice-lines
evidence: pkg_invoicing.fn_invoice_lines (04_pkg_invoicing.sql:106-109, ap-620d0a2057): lines of an invoice ordered by line_no, replayed for every invoice over the lines embed
source_sql: SELECT invoice_id AS "invoiceId", line_no AS "lineNo", line_type AS "lineType", description AS "description", amount AS "amount" FROM invoice_lines ORDER BY invoice_id, line_no

name: invoices-next-dunning-attempt
evidence: pkg_dunning.sp_schedule_dunning (05_pkg_dunning.sql:43-44, ap-37287a11b5): NVL(MAX(attempt_no), 0) per overdue invoice, read from the dunningAttempts embed
source_sql: SELECT i.id AS "invoiceId", (SELECT NVL(MAX(d.attempt_no), 0) FROM dunning_attempts d WHERE d.invoice_id = i.id) AS "lastAttemptNo" FROM invoices i WHERE i.status_cd = 40
